previous_statement: Because both data have the same delta, their source sets and formulas for Pi_delta are identical. Each target is the image of that same Pi_delta, hence S_grp=S_pol=S_delta. Applying lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality therefore yields (u_grp,h_grp)=(u_pol,h_pol) on S_grp intersect S_pol=S_delta, in particular u_grp=u_pol on S_delta.
new_statement: The equality-of-images argument is only conditional: if a second polar datum (delta,S_grp,u_grp,h_grp) satisfying the antecedent of lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality existed for u_grp, then its having the same delta and source formula Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H as the retraction datum would imply S_grp=S_delta and coherence would give u_grp=u_pol on S_delta. But 1.7.7.1 establishes that the exact allowed contracts supply no such second datum. Therefore this antecedent is unavailable, lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality cannot be applied to u_grp, and no equality u_grp=u_pol follows from this branch.
